headline: U.S. Announces $2 Billion CHIPS Investment to Establish Quantum Computing Leadership
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce is allocating $2 billion from the CHIPS Act to nine companies, including IBM and GlobalFoundries, to accelerate domestic quantum computing development and establish dedicated foundries. This foundational investment aims to secure U.S. leadership in future AI infrastructure and advanced semiconductor fabrication, significantly impacting global tech geopolitics and long-term supply chain resilience.
